svg.aria-label: An n8n workflow that splits at IF and rejoins at Merge, then three frames of the compiled net running. IF routes data to A and an empty token to B. A runs and B skips, but the skip still delivers an empty to Merge. Both of Merge's input slots are claimed and one carries data, so Merge starts without any stuck-join fallback.
svg.title: The empty token, and why the join never sticks
svg.text: IF takes one branch · B is never reached · Merge still runs
The branch IF did not take emits an empty token,
not nothing. Every edge resolves, always.
B’s skip consumes the empty and passes an empty on.
Both of Merge’s inputs are now accounted for.
The data arrival raises has data. The empty one does not.
Both slots are ready; only slot 0 brought data.
All slots ready and one holding data is the whole condition.
Start consumes all three, and Merge runs on A’s data alone.
to A: A/in · to B: B/in_empty · from A: in0_e0 · from B: in1_e5_empty · claim slot 0: arm_e0_data · claim slot 1: arm_e5_empty
slot i ready: ready_i · has data: hasdata · running: Merge/running. Compiler names, read off dotExport() of the compiled diamond fixture.
